audit.why: Level 2 (E-root through plant), level 6 (R vs R), first item (E-root plant-burst kill setup), and late (R-plant zoning) interactions are already correctly and specifically stated in content.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].t uses "his" for Zyra, who is female per champ-gender.js.

audit.why: The packet's own defect note ("level chart contradicts data: Morgana wins 52.52% but the chart gives Zyra 7/7 stages") is a low-sample (1371 games) artifact, not a contradiction to fix in our writable fields — content already correctly and consistently states Zyra favoured across every listed phase; the game-level win rate reflects factors outside the 7 tracked lane phases (jungler/teamfight swings after 2+ items) and both content and packet agree with each other, so nothing here needed correction.
